snippet.title: BRAVERY — Official Gameplay Trailer | JD Games
snippet.description:
⭐ Add BRAVERY to your Steam wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4387160/BRAVERY/?utm_source=youtube

Discover BRAVERY, an adventure seen through the eyes of a tiny matchstick hero.

Explore a house and its surroundings where everyday objects become obstacles, familiar places hide surprises, and even the family cat can become a formidable threat. Take flight in a miniature helicopter and discover the world from a different perspective.

Subscribe to JD Games for more gameplay and development updates.

Thanks for watching!

#BRAVERY #IndieGame #GameplayTrailer
